description: Published polygon layers with no per-feature name in their tiles. Verified against the actual archives on 2026-08-23 by scripts/assign-missing-label-properties.mjs. These are flood extents, noise contours, elevation bands and water bodies identified only by codes -- there is nothing to label them with, so no labelProperty is the honest state. Listed so a NEW unlabelled layer fails the gate instead of joining them silently.
